people.Riksharaja: The vanara king of Kishkindha; foster-father of Vali and Sugriva, who were begotten of the gods Indra and Surya.

Vali.note: Elder vanara prince, son of Indra; king of Kishkindha of peerless strength, slain by Rama's arrow to restore Sugriva.

people.Sugriva: Younger vanara prince, son of Surya; exiled by Vali and restored by Rama, whose army of vanaras he then led to Lanka.
people.Sushena: Vanara elder and physician; father of Tara.

Tara.note: Daughter of Sushena; the wise queen of Vali, and after him of Sugriva. Mother of Angada.

people.Angada: Son of Vali and Tara; the vanara prince who led Rama's embassy to Ravana.
people.Kesari: A vanara chief; the earthly father of Hanuman.

Anjana.note: An apsara born as a vanara; mother of Hanuman.

Hanuman.note: Son of Kesari and Anjana, begotten by Vayu the wind-god; the immortal devotee of Rama who leapt to Lanka and found Sita.

Vayu.name: Vayu Deva
Vayu.note: The deva of the wind; father of Hanuman, whose boundless strength and flight are his gift.

Indra.name: Indra Deva
Indra.note: King of the devas; the divine father of the vanara king Vali.
